info.title: AI Shopping Copilot Backend
info.description: Backend API for AI Shopping Copilot Chrome Extension

get.description: Database/schema readiness only; does not spend model/speech quota.

post.description: Create an anonymous user and return an opaque bearer token.
Revoke the authenticated bearer token, including access to owned chat routes.
Create a new chat session for the current user.

get.description:
Retrieve session by ID.
Users can only see their own sessions; another user's session ID returns 404 (not 403).

post.description:
Post a message in a session.
Idempotent by request_id: replaying with the same request_id returns the saved reply
with header Idempotent-Replay: true.

get.description: Retrieve shopping context for a session.

patch.description:
Update shopping context with optimistic locking on version.
Preferences merge, null values delete keys.

post.description:
Add product rejection to session context.
User must have captured a snapshot of the listing. Idempotent 200 on duplicate.

delete.description: Remove a product rejection from session context.

post.description:
Ingest a product snapshot captured by the Chrome extension.
Upserts listing, records snapshot, and tracks price observation.

Record a price observation for an existing listing.
Requires caller to have captured at least one snapshot for this listing (otherwise 409 LISTING_NOT_SEEN).
Enforces rate limits on hourly and daily observation counts (otherwise 429 RATE_LIMITED).
Reuses 6h deduplication and >50% jump logic.
Atomically triggers active qualifying alerts with trusted-observation rules.

get.description:
Retrieve historical price observations and deal statistics for a listing.
Accepted observations only. Returns insufficient_data when fewer than 3 points.
Resolution can be 'daily' (lowest accepted price per day) or 'raw'.

post.description:
Generate or retrieve cached review summary for a listing.
Requires user to have captured at least one snapshot for this listing.

get.description:
Retrieve latest stored review summary for a listing.
Returns 404 NO_SUMMARY if none exists.

post.description:
Create a new price alert on a listing.
Rejects with 409 ALERT_ALREADY_EXISTS if an active alert already exists for this listing.

get.description: List all alerts belonging to the current user, optionally filtered by status and listing_id.

schema.title: Response List Alerts V1 Alerts Get

patch.description:
Update target_price or cancel an alert.
Requires matching current version (optimistic locking); returns 409 on version mismatch.
Another user's alert ID returns 404.

post.description:
Rearm a triggered alert back to active, incrementing arm_count.
Only triggered alerts can be rearmed; active alerts return 400.
Another user's alert ID returns 404.

get.description: List notifications for current user, default status=pending.

schema.title: Response List Notifications V1 Notifications Get

post.description:
Internal maintenance job endpoint:
- Verifies X-Job-Secret header using constant-time comparison
- Expires outdated auth tokens
- Purges snapshots older than 30 days
- Purges messages older than 30 days
- Purges notifications older than 90 days
- Idempotent: running repeatedly returns 200 without error
Extract first; optional model may select fact IDs, never prose or actions.

get.description: Advertise configuration, not live upstream health or internal grants.

schema.title: Response Work V1 Ai Conversations  Conversation Id  Work Get

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.default: Only supplied observations; not all products or all customer reviews.

VisibleExecution.title: VisibleExecution
VisibleExecution.description:
The executor must enforce these, not merely display a progress message.

Its packaged site adapter performs scrolling/typing/clicks as appropriate for
the semantic tool. Arbitrary scripts/selectors/URLs are never model arguments.
